workouts.title: EE|RO 0.1 Testing (Week 0, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Welcome to the Day 3 of the Endless Engine testing. Today you'll be lacing up your running shoes and recording your 5km run time. Whether it takes 75 minutes or 15, aim to run at a consistent, manageable pace for the entire distance. Ultimately, take the time you need to finish and if you need to pull it back to a walk, do so and add in bursts of steady jogging when you're ready. Use an website like On the Go Map or Google Maps to measure your route before hand or an app on your phone / watch like Strava, Adidas Running or Runkeeper, to name a few. Under the Files tab, download the attached Endless Engine - Running Only Score Sheet and use it too record this week’s Test scores so you can measure your improvement between Week 1 to Week 8 and make note of the training splits you'll need to hit throughout the program.

items.movement: Plan out your route, and when you’re ready, click start on your stopwatch and record your total time from start to finish.

workouts.title: EE|RO 0.2 Testing (Week 0, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Day 2 of our Initial Testing is a designated rest day to give you ample time to recover and ensure you’re ready to go for the 400m time trial on Day 0.3.

items.movement: Take it easy today. Go for an easy walk, bike or better yet, follow along with Coach Garry's Mobility Flow.

workouts.title: EE|RO 0.3 Testing (Week 0, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Welcome to the last day of our Initial Testing. Today you'll be setting your 400m sprint time. Not running on a track? Use an website like On the Go Map to measure out 400 metres. It doesn't have to be perfect as long you run the same route in week 8. Don't forget to add today's results to your Score Sheet.

items.movement: With your route set and you’re ready to test, click start on your stopwatch and record your total time to run 400m from start to finish.

workouts.title: EE|RO 1.1 (Week 1, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Welcome to your first official Endless Engine - Running Only run workout! Aim for a 85% interval running speed that should feel as fast as but not faster than your 5km pace. The speed needs to be REPEATABLE for all the intervals programmed. The goal is to increase cycle rate during short intervals (ie. run faster with good technique while decreasing the rest) which will allow us to be faster when it comes to our next 5k test.

workouts.title: EE|RO 1.2 (Week 1, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Today, we'll be doing 800m intervals but make note of how the work is split up. If you're running on a track, you'll go 400m, then for the next 200m you'll increase the pace then finish it off by walking the last 200m. When you get back to your starting position, start the next interval. On a 'there and back again' course, run out 400m, turn around and increase your pace for 200m before walking the remaining distance back. When you get return to your starting mark, turn around and start the next interval.

If not, no worries—just settle into an easy, continuous jog. It’s all good.
